about: Every tool Shepherd registers, where, and the verdict (docs/context-budget.md). keep: sent in every request of the context; defer: still sent today, to move behind pi 1.0's tool_search in Phase B; drop: not registered there any more, with why. Tests/Extensions/context-budget.test.mjs launches each context on a real pi and fails when a tool it registers has no row, or a dropped one is back. The groups are what the Context card's system-prompt breakdown calls them (ContextToolGroups).

families.reason: pi's own: what an agent does with a repository.
The thread's terminal tabs (command-J) are how an agent runs a dev server or a watcher; six small tools, 590 tokens together.

Reaching other threads is something the user asks for, and each description now says so first (agent-to-agent messages); 1.4k tokens in every thread for a rare use. Defer behind tool_search in Phase B.
Messaging another thread is the user's call in a thread (defer in Phase B). An automation's run reports completion to the thread that made it with it, the only agent tool a run gets.
Managing automations is rare; 0.8k tokens. A run's own agent never gets them (an automation cannot start automations). Defer in Phase B.
One small tool an unattended run needs to say it finished.
Readies the side pane's Changes tab. A design's screen has no Changes tab and its folder is no repository, so a design's agent no longer gets it (dropped now). Defer for threads in Phase B.
Delegating to a helper is a choice the model makes now and then; 1.6k tokens. Defer behind tool_search in Phase B (a design's agent relays its tools through them).
A scripted run of helpers: one of the heaviest single descriptions (about 390 tokens) for the rarest use. Defer in Phase B.
Missions are deferred and no screen shows them, so the model gets no mission tool or parameter and no record is written for a run (dropped now; SHEPHERD_MISSIONS=1 brings it back).

The thread's own Browser page: 13 tools and 5 prompt rules, 2.2k tokens in every thread, and most threads never open a page. Registered where it works (a design's agent has no Browser); the first Phase B candidate.

pi 1.0's own tool search, which loads the tools of the MCP servers left on Search (docs/mcp.md): about 190 tokens with the server list in the prompt, present only while a server is on Search. A server set to Direct declares its own mcp__<server>__<tool> tools instead: the user's, not listed here.
Registered only once the thread holds a design reference.
Registered only while Settings > Experiments > Suggested instructions is on for the kind of agent.
What a design's agent draws and edits with; no other agent gets them.
A native subagent's only way to ask its parent; registered in a child's own pi.
